description: A modern dental clinic landing page built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tailwind CSS, deployed on Cloudflare Pages with an Email API-powered contact form for seamless client inquiries.

A personal portfolio website built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, deployed on **Cloudflare Pages with a serverless Email API for contact form submissions, showcasing my skills, projects, and experience as a Virtual Assistant and Web Developer.

A full-stack investment portfolio analysis platform built with React, Node.js, Express.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Recharts. Developed as part of a four-person Agile team, focusing on backend architecture, data flow, functionality, UX design, and testing.

A 2D platformer game developed in Unity using C#. Implemented core gameplay mechanics, player movement, game logic, collision handling, and overall functionality, while integrating custom game assets created by a collaborating designer.
